exposure: fetal vital status at admission (fetal heartbeat)
cohort: The study included registry data on 105,872 babies weighing 1000g or more, born to women aged 13 to 50 years at 16 hospitals in Benin, Malawi, Uganda, and United Republic of Tanzania.
finding: Unknown fetal heartbeat at admission was associated with a significantly higher odds of caesarean section for both antepartum (aOR: 2.55) and intrapartum (aOR: 2.08) stillbirths.
mod_finding: The study concludes that decision-making processes on the mode of birth need to be better understood, especially given diagnostic uncertainty regarding fetal vital status.
country: Benin, Malawi, Uganda, United Republic of Tanzania
cross-section timing: Data collected between 1 July 2021 and 30 June 2023
